03-22-1020 is March 22, 1020.  
12 weeks = 84 days. Plus 1 day = 85 days subtracted.  
March 22 minus 85 days:  
March has 31 days, so March 22 → 21 days in March.  
Remaining 85 - 21 = 64 days earlier.  
February 1020 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 400? 1020/4=255, yes leap year) → 29 days in Feb.  
64 - 29 = 35 days earlier into January.  
January has 31 days, so 35 - 31 = 4 days earlier into December 1019.  
December 31, 1019 minus 4 days = December 27, 1019.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1019-12-27
